title: Assistant Professor of Financial Economics, Department of Economics (R0008846)
description:
Description

WAKE FOREST UNIVERSITY. The Department of Economics invites
applications for a tenure-track faculty position as Assistant
Professor of Economics, effective July 1, 2027.

JEL Classifications: G - Financial Economics, E44: Financial
Markets and the Macroeconomy, F3: International Finance

Qualifications : Candidates should possess a Ph.D. in
Economics, Finance, or a related field; ABD candidates will also be
considered. Qualified applicants will demonstrate their ability to
teach undergraduate courses, initiate and sustain original research
and scholarship in financial economics or related fields, and
contribute to an academic environment that fosters learning and
growth for all its stakeholders.

Position Summary : This individual will be expected to teach
undergraduate courses in financial economics and related areas; the
ability to teach courses such as household finance, macro-finance,
or personal finance will be especially valued. The successful
candidate will also engage in scholarly activities; participate in
departmental, College, and University service; and contribute to
the University’s community outreach efforts.

Application Instructions : Review of applications will begin
immediately. Complete applications should include a cover letter
briefly describing the candidate's teaching and research interests,
curriculum vitae, job market paper, statement of teaching
philosophy, and three letters of recommendation. Applications
submitted on or before November 10th will receive full
consideration. To apply, visit: hr.wfu.edu/careers .
Inquiries should be directed to Prof. Aeimit Lakdawala, Chair of
the Search Committee, at lakdawa@wfu.edu or to Wake Forest
University Human Resources at askhr@wfu.edu . Wake Forest University
conducts background investigations for all final faculty candidates
being considered for employment.

About the Department of Economics : The Department of
Economics at Wake Forest is one of the most popular majors in the
College, and our students are bright and engaged. Our faculty are
committed to excellence in both teaching and research, supported by
an active research seminar. As a collegiate university dedicated to
the Teacher-Scholar model, we seek a colleague with an active and
ambitious research agenda and a commitment to deeply engaged
teaching of undergraduate students.

About Wake Forest University: Founded in 1834, Wake Forest
University is a private, coeducational institution dedicated to
academic excellence in liberal arts, graduate, and professional
education. With more than 5,400 undergraduates and 3,800 graduate
and professional students, Wake Forest is a collegiate university
offering a vibrant, intellectual community with a rich cultural
life, an impressive array of facilities, and a strong athletics
program competing in the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC). Since its
founding, the University has adopted the motto Pro
Humanitate, which is exemplified by a deep institutional
commitment to public service and engagement with the world. For
more information, visit: about.wfu.edu .

Wake Forest University is located in Winston-Salem, a beautiful,
mid-sized city centrally in the Piedmont-Triad region of North
Carolina. To learn more about Winston-Salem, visit: www.visitwinstonsalem.com
.
